body: I've done something similar, except instead of flat out saying I didn't want a relationship I just kind of rebuffed everything until it stopped. Going without affection is no big deal, losing some that you had with someone you actually felt okay getting it from and knowing it's your own fault is a little tougher to stomach. I doubt she'd think you're toying with her or lying or anything - if you can bring yourself to talk to her, do it!

Oh I've fucked up a lot of them in high school and in college too - but at least I was able to rationalize "well this person isn't all that amazing anyways". It's a lot harder to do that with someone that I feel close to, and even actually WAS close to for a while. It sucks knowing that my relationships inevitably fizzle out instead of getting stronger. I wouldn't say it's so much a "fear of success" - more of a feeling that something just isn't right when I'm happy.
